display_long_description:
Fruit Ninja VR: Ghostbusters is a fast-paced virtual reality arcade action game that blends classic fruit-slicing gameplay with supernatural ghost-hunting combat. Step into a neon-infused haunted world where you become a ninja exorcist armed with proton-powered blades and responsive VR motion controls designed for immersive gameplay.

Your objective is to slice flying fruit with precision, build combo streaks, and survive waves of paranormal enemies that invade eerie environments. Every level challenges your reflexes, timing, and accuracy as you dodge cursed objects, explosive traps, and aggressive ghost attacks.

Features:
• Immersive VR motion slicing gameplay 🎮 for full immersion
• Fruit slicing arcade action 🍉 with fast-paced challenges
• Ghost battles 👻 in haunted arenas
• Combo system ⚔️ for high score combos
• Boss fights 👹 with unique attack patterns
• Co-op mode 🤝 multiplayer support
• Survival mode 🔥 endless waves challenge
• Haunted environments 🏚️ dynamic spooky visuals
• Responsive controls 🕹️ smooth VR tracking

Progress through increasingly difficult missions while unlocking new challenges and refining your slicing skills. Compete for high scores, improve your accuracy, and master combo chains to dominate leaderboards. Each session delivers replayable arcade intensity with unpredictable enemy waves and evolving difficulty. Experience action-packed VR combat where speed, precision, and strategy decide your survival in a chaotic supernatural world.
